title: Requirements-change record front-matter
description: The HTML-comment front-matter block at the top of a requirements-change record (context/<tier>/requirements/changes/REQ-CHANGE-<NNN>-<slug>.md). Keys are the <!-- key: value --> lines. Shape-only, like requirements-frontmatter.schema.json: it never validates the record's body sections. See STANDARD-REQ.md.

req-change.description: Zero-padded sequence number, per tier, independent of the REQ-<NNN> sequence it documents.

spec-change.description: Absent while status is open. On a closed record, names the covering CHANGE-<NNN>, or is the literal not-required for a revision that produces no spec delta. Set together with status, by mc.py req change-close only.
